title: Adjacent-protection violation, then nothing recorded for 21 days
detail: Checked DOB, ECB and safety violations and DOB complaints (code 03) on the site and its 5 touching lots, dated in the year before 2026-06-01.

title: Stop-work order, then a violation for continuing work
detail: Checked violation text, complaint dispositions and 311 resolutions on the site and its 5 touching lots, dated in the year before 2026-06-01.

sources.name: 311 service requests routed to DOB (2020 on)

title: Structural complaint within 90 days of earth work next door
detail: 1 earth-work, foundation or SOE job across the site and its 5 touching lots, each checked for complaints in codes 30, 14, 16 or 5C on the lots next to it within 90 days of its filing or first permit, before 2026-06-01.

title: Heavy rain or freeze-thaw during an open excavation
detail: No earth-work, foundation or SOE permit across the site and its 5 touching lots was issued before 2026-06-01, so there was no open excavation to check the weather against.
